summary.text: Conflux takes place on Alara, where the five shards merge into one plane and war breaks out along every border as new colors of mana flood each world.

It follows Nicol Bolas, who fomented chaos and destroyed the obelisks to speed the merging, and his minions such as Malfegor, Rakka Mar and the Order of the Skyward Eye, while Naya's prophet Mayael is guided by visions of the awakening Progenitus.
Bolas is stopped from destroying all of Alara by the planeswalker Ajani Goldmane, who absorbs the last of the Maelstrom and banishes him from the plane.
